author: Krono III
title: Algo Arc 1: Multi-Epoch PPO
abstract: This is the first experiment in my third research arc focused on algorithmic refinement. I am testing a modified PPO training step that performs multiple gradient updates (4 epochs) per collected trajectory. I hypothesize this will improve sample efficiency and lead to a higher score than the current single-epoch implementation. All architectural components are held at the SOTA configuration.
